## 2026-10-13 - [DOM-based XSS in Global Error Handlers]
**Vulnerability:** Found `innerHTML` being used with unsanitized error messages and stack traces in `window.onerror` and `window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection')` inside `src/main.tsx`.
**Learning:** Even though error messages and stack traces are usually generated by the browser, they can contain unsanitized user input depending on what the user inputted or what data caused the crash, which could lead to DOM-based XSS if directly rendered with `innerHTML`.
**Prevention:** Avoid using `innerHTML` with potentially unsanitized data (e.g., in global error handlers). Always prefer safe DOM APIs like `document.createElement`, `innerText`, and `appendChild` to prevent DOM-based XSS vulnerabilities.
